name: stl.quest
description: A private 3D-print request and production queue for resin and filament printers.

scripts.build: ras build && tsx scripts/checkBuiltAssets.ts && esbuild src/server/assets/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=.output/server/assets-worker.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild scripts/seedPreview.ts --bundle --external:better-sqlite3 --external:argon2 --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --define:import.meta.env.PROD=true --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=.output/server/seed-preview.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild scripts/containerRuntime.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=.output/server/container-runtime.mjs --log-level=warning && ras assets sync
scripts.realtime: ras realtime --config realtime.json --name stlquest-realtime-dev --port 8000 --origin http://localhost:3000 --secret stlquest-development-realtime-secret
scripts.check:ci: ras sync --check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm changesets:check && pnpm check:docs && pnpm db:check && pnpm catalog:check && pnpm check:unraid && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:cli
scripts.catalog:check: tsx scripts/syncPrinterCatalog.ts --check && tsx scripts/syncResinCatalog.ts --check && tsx scripts/syncElectricityCatalog.ts --check && tsx scripts/checkEquipmentCatalog.ts
scripts.catalog:sync: tsx scripts/syncPrinterCatalog.ts && tsx scripts/syncResinCatalog.ts && tsx scripts/syncElectricityCatalog.ts && tsx scripts/checkEquipmentCatalog.ts
scripts.catalog:update: tsx scripts/syncPrinterCatalog.ts --update && tsx scripts/updatePrinterImages.ts --update && tsx scripts/syncPrinterCatalog.ts && tsx scripts/syncResinCatalog.ts --update && tsx scripts/syncElectricityCatalog.ts && tsx scripts/checkEquipmentCatalog.ts
